test_array_attributes: test the numpy_array module functions ndim, shape, strides, writeable, size, itemsize, nbytes, and owndata on numpy arrays
test_index_offset: test the numpy_array module functions index_at, index_at_t, offset_at, and offset_at for computing array element indices and byte offsets
test_data: test the numpy_array module functions data and data_t for accessing raw array data with optional index arguments
test_mutate_data: test the numpy_array module functions mutate_data and mutate_data_t for in-place modification of array elements
test_wrap: test the numpy_array module wrap function for creating numpy array views that reference the same underlying data buffer
